candidates.snippet: 1875: Studies at the Polytechnic Institute - Tesla began his engineering studies at the Higher Technical School in Graz, Austria. 1884: Moves to Paris - Tesla relocated to Paris to work for the Continental Edison Company. 1892: Publishes 'Experiments with Alternate Currents' - Tesla published his seminal work detailing his research on high-frequency AC. 1901: Wardenclyffe Tower project begins - Construction began on Tesla's ambitious wireless power transmission project.
